name: weekly_review
description: Guard reads logs at weekly meetings and confirms excess catches

prompt.template:
You are acting as the lake guard. Please review the weekly logs and confirm any excess catches.

Report the fishers with lowest catches to be assigned community service.

Respond with ONLY this JSON object, nothing else:
{{"low_catch_fishers": ["<agent_id>"], "reasoning": "<one or two sentences, in character>"}}
